name: The Nightmare Winter
source:
The game is based on real events in Ukraine that happened on February 24, 2022. We offer to see the war through the eyes of Alisa - an ordinary student from Mariupol, whose family wakes up at 4 am from explosions outside the window. The purpose of Alisa's life changes after that morning and she has only one goal - to save herself, her mother and sister by moving out of the city, which is constantly under fire, to her grandmother in Zaporizhzhia. During this day you can learn more about Alice's family, develop a relationship with her mother, see the feelings of children during the war through the eyes of the younger sister of the main character and find the answer to the question: what happened to her father? During the game, you are accompanied by various close people of Alice, one of whom is her friend Stas, a young blue-haired guy from Mariupol, with whom she always stays in touch, and how long will they stay in contact? Will you be able to survive on February 24? It all depends on you and your choice, but remember that even after the end there is a possibility to change everything.

[From [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/TheNightmareWinter/767909]Gamejolt[/url]]
translation:
本作根據2022年2月24日發生於烏克蘭的真實事件改編。玩家將透過普通學生阿麗薩的視角見證戰爭。她和家人凌晨4點被窗外的爆炸聲驚醒。那天早晨之後，阿麗薩的人生目標發生改變：她只想帶著自己、母親和妹妹離開不斷遭受砲火襲擊的城市，前往札波羅熱投奔祖母。

在這一天裡，你可以進一步瞭解阿麗薩的家庭，與她的母親建立關係，透過主角妹妹的視角感受戰爭中孩子們的心情，並找出父親究竟遭遇了什麼。遊戲過程中，阿麗薩的親友會陪伴在她身邊，其中包括她的朋友斯塔斯。他是來自馬立波、留著藍髮的年輕男子，兩人一直保持聯絡；但他們還能聯絡多久？你能在2月24日活下來嗎？這一切取決於你和你的選擇。不過請記住，即使結局已至，仍然有機會改變一切。[引自[url=https://gamejolt.com/games/TheNightmareWinter/767909]Gamejolt[/url]]
